Inspection: standalone setup/frame handling and API documentation examined;
source searched for network requests and dynamic-code execution (no matches).
This is not a comprehensive third-party security audit. There is no endpoint
for evaluating submitted JavaScript; scene.mjs is an agent-authored local module.
The app uses only local assets. Original study pages disable network connections;
the batch page permits same-origin JSON reads, with no external connections, through
Content-Security-Policy. Do not reuse this as an untrusted-code sandbox.
